description: Discover every public HTTP API, registered MCP tool, and operation in the generated HelloBooks accounting API reference. Search/filter and follow nextPage for all results; pass id for full parameter/input-schema/response and authorization details. This returns documentation; authenticated accounting calls use company-scoped OAuth at the documented API host.

id.description: Return one entry with its complete input/schema/response details.

pageSize.description: Default 50. Follow nextPage to enumerate every entry.

query.description: Search name, operation, path, description or scope.

name: list_api_catalog
